headline_marked: Samsung Teases [[Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide]] on Instagram
headline: Samsung Teases Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide on Instagram
summary: The company is hinting at a wider new foldable addition
details: Samsung has started teasing its upcoming foldables on Instagram, offering an early glimpse at what to expect. The company's profile features jigsaw puzzle-shaped objects and the tagline, "New Shape. New Joy."

The teaser campaign hints at the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Fold 8 Ultra, and their Flip sibling. Samsung has not officially announced the date for its next Galaxy Unpacked event, though rumors point to July 22 as the most likely date.

The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide's wider aspect ratio and more compact form factor could make it a better fit for most users. A wider cover display would make the phone easier to type on, more comfortable to use one-handed, and practical enough to handle everyday tasks without unfolding it every time.

Given the DRAM and NAND supply crunch, Samsung will most likely increase the prices of its 2026 foldable lineup. The Galaxy Z Fold 7 already costs $2,000, and its successor may carry an even higher price tag.
caption:

The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide's wider aspect ratio and more compact form factor could make it a better fit for most users. A wider cover display would make the phone easier to type on, more comfortable to use one-handed, and practical enough to handle everyday tasks without unfolding it every time.

Given the DRAM and NAND supply crunch, Samsung will most likely increase the prices of its 2026 foldable lineup. The Galaxy Z Fold 7 already costs $2,000, and its successor may carry an even higher price tag.
